### Headline summary
- The US Treasury Department has taken systems offline following a cybersecurity incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its infrastructure. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/treasury-fincen-takes-systems-offline-after-cyber-incident), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/us-treasurys-fincen-disconnects-systems-following-cyber-incident/))
- Attackers are actively exploiting critical unpatched vulnerabilities in Drupal core, GeoServer, and Danfoss refrigeration controllers to achieve remote code execution and breach production systems. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/drupal-critical-security-flaw/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/two-newly-disclosed-geoserver-vulnerabilities-under-attack/), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-warns-of-critical-unpatched-flaw-in-danfoss-refrigeration-controllers/))
- Switzerland has confirmed its first cases of AI-assisted cyberattacks that successfully compromised IT systems, while researchers warn that AI penetration testing tools are increasingly being weaponized by cybercriminals. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/switzerland-ai-agent-cyberattacks/), [Threat Wire (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x-fBu4FlP2Y))

### Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after cybersecurity incident
The Treasury Department has taken some systems offline after a cybersecurity incident that “resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems.” ([The Record](https://therecord.media/treasury-fincen-takes-systems-offline-after-cyber-incident), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/us-treasurys-fincen-disconnects-systems-following-cyber-incident/))

### Hackers Are Exploiting a Critical Drupal Flaw to Target Websites Without Needing a Password
Hackers are exploiting CVE-2026-132165, a critical flaw in Drupal core that can let them take over a website or run code on its server without a password. The Drupal Security Team’s advisory says attacks against live sites were reported as early as November 19, 2026, at 19:00 UTC. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/drupal-critical-security-flaw/))

### Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/two-newly-disclosed-geoserver-vulnerabilities-under-attack/))

### CISA warns of critical unpatched flaw in Danfoss refrigeration controllers
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning about a critical vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controllers used by food retailers to manage commercial refrigeration, HVAC, and lighting systems. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-warns-of-critical-unpatched-flaw-in-danfoss-refrigeration-controllers/))

### Switzerland Confirms First AI-Agent Cyberattacks That Successfully Compromised IT Systems
Switzerland’s National Cyber Security Center (NCSC) has confirmed its first cases of AI-assisted cyberattacks against organizations in the country. The attacks affected companies and critical infrastructure operators across at least two sectors. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/switzerland-ai-agent-cyberattacks/))

### Hackers Exploit Fortinet Flaws to Breach Commercial Ships and Access Control Networks
U.S. authorities are investigating whether Iran was behind cyberattacks that may have compromised up to 50 commercial ships. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/fortinet-flaws-to-breach-commercial-ships/))

### Task Management App Todoist Hacked, Attackers Breach Production Systems
Task management app Todoist said an attacker breached its production systems on November 23, 2026, and downloaded account records for about 6% of its users. The records contained email addresses, account creation dates, and older password hashes, not plaintext passwords. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/todoist-production-system-breach/))

### Attackers Target .NET Developers With Poisoned Job Assessments
Researchers discovered 13 malicious NuGet packages as part of a fake recruitment campaign that spreads malware and gives attackers access to developers' machines. ([Dark Reading](https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/attackers-net-developers-poisoned-job-assessments))
